exam.title: TOEIC Listening Sample (Part 1 Photograph & Part 2 Question-Response)

groups.imageAlt: A person writing notes in a notebook at an office desk.
groups.transcript: (A) He is walking down the hallway. (B) He is writing in a notebook. (C) He is driving a vehicle. (D) He is closing a window.

questions.stem: Look at the photograph and choose the statement that best describes what you see.
questions.explanation: Statement (B) accurately describes the action shown in the photo.
questions.hint: Focus on the main subject's hands and activity.

options.label: A
options.text: (A) He is walking down the hallway.
options.rationale: Incorrect action; the person is seated at a desk.

options.label: B
options.text: (B) He is writing in a notebook.
options.rationale: Directly corresponds to the action depicted in the photograph.

options.label: D
options.rationale: No window interaction is taking place.

groups.transcript: Where did you leave the contract files? (A) On Mr. Davis's desk. (B) Yes, yesterday morning. (C) It was signed by both parties.

questions.stem: Where did you leave the contract files?
questions.explanation: Question starts with 'Where', requiring a location response.
questions.hint: Identify the question word (Where) which asks for a place.

options.label: A
options.rationale: Directly answers 'Where' with a specific location.

options.label: B
options.rationale: 'Yes' is inappropriate for a WH-question; also answers 'When', not 'Where'.

options.label: C
options.text: It was signed by both parties.
options.rationale: Answers a question about status, not location.
